activities.name: The Albanian Riviera
activities.note: many hotels, restaurants and activity operators close from mid- or late September to early or mid-June, and November to April are very quiet

windows.reason: the best months: pleasant weather, fewer crowds and fairer prices than peak summer
quieter and cheaper still, but many hotels, beach clubs and tour operators close for the off-season
peak summer: sweltering heat, sky-high prices and overcrowded beaches

activities.name: Valbona–Theth pass hike
activities.note: snow lies on the high ground from October or November until March or April

windows.reason: guided trips over the pass run from mid-May to mid-October, after the snowmelt
a public holiday on 14 March, celebrated hardest in Elbasan, with bonfires on the eve and ballokume cookies
